system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent prompt files agents/leader.md etc.; brief and memory rendered into the prompt each cycle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Code Agent: Experiment implementation and execution. Tools:run shell,launch experiment,write file,read file,list files(5 tools).
env_context_strategy.note: Project brief also injected (file_notes-like), but repo exploration is via read_file/list_files.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Auto-compacted: when the section exceeds 1,200 characters, the oldest entry is removed.
context_compaction.note: Log tail limited to last 50 lines = tool_output_pruning; memory compaction is heuristic summarization.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Log tail: Reading the last 50 lines of the training log provides the latest metrics

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Each tool definition adds approximately 200 tokens to every API call (name, description, parameter schema).
tool_call_format.note: Provider tool schemas implied; parser code not shown in evidence.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Tools: log memory,write file,read file(3 tools).
tool_count.note: Leader has 3 tools; workers 4 (Idea), 5 (Code), 3 (Writing). Max shipped per agent is 5.

edit_primitive.note: Only a write_file tool is listed; no diff/search-replace primitive reported.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Tools:run shell,launch experiment,write file,read file,list files(5 tools).
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mentioned anywhere in README or paper tool registry.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Deep Researcher Agent operates as a continuous loop over three phases
loop_primitives.note: THINK→EXECUTE→REFLECT fixed cycle; plan produced in THINK then executed.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: plan t←THINK(B, M t−1, d){LLM active}
planning_granularity.note: A plan object exists per cycle but is not a persisted structured task list; closest is implicit.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the Leader agent makes strategic decisions and dispatches tasks to specialized Worker agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Leader dispatches at most 3 worker tasks per cycle.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Three intervention mechanisms are provided: (1) aHUMAN DIRECTIVE.mdfile consumed at the start of each cycle with highest priority
human_in_loop.note: Steering by directive file/flag/memory edit; not per-call approval strictly — closest values chosen.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Critical state files (state.json, MEMORY LOG.md,PROJECT BRIEF.md) cannot be overwritten

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Tier 2: Memory Log (M).An agent-maintained rolling log
long_term_memory.note: MEMORY_LOG.md persists across cycles/runs; 7 Claude Code skills installed as reusable procedures.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Critical state files (state.json, MEMORY LOG.md,PROJECT BRIEF.md) cannot be overwritten by worker agents
state_persistence.note: state.json plus memory files let a restarted loop continue; no explicit resume code cited.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the Code Agent must execute a short dry-run (typically 2 forward-backward steps) to verify that the code runs without errors.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The agent will analyze the crash, fix the code, and retry.
retry_policy.note: Cycles repeat until goal reached or max_cycles; max_cycles: -1 = run forever by default.

rollback.evidence_quote: Protected Files.Critical state files (state.json, MEMORY LOG.md,PROJECT BRIEF.md) cannot be overwritten by worker agents
rollback.note: Safety mechanisms section lists no undo/revert/snapshot facility.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
max_cycles: -1 # -1 = run forever
max_steps_per_cycle: 3 # Max worker dispatches per cycle
termination_condition.note: Default max_cycles=-1 (unlimited); anti-burn cooldown backoff is stall handling.

cost_controls.note: Memory caps bound context; provider/model selectable in config.yaml (anthropic/openai, fast/strongest tiers).

timeouts.evidence_quote: poll_interval: 900 # Check every 15 min during training
timeouts.note: Brief constraints cap training length per run; no harness wall-clock run timeout reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Launching training: nohup python train.py --config config.yaml
execution_isolation.note: Runs directly on the host GPU server; no container mentioned.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The Code Agent can read, write, and modify any file in your project.
filesystem_access.note: Full host access except protected files.

network_policy.note: No network restriction configured anywhere; downloads and arXiv search assume open egress.

permission_model.evidence_quote: It won't touch protected files (PROJECT_BRIEF.md, MEMORY_LOG.md).
permission_model.note: Protected-file blocklist plus mandatory dry-run; otherwise actions execute unapproved.

tracing.evidence_quote: Reading the last 50 lines of the training log provides the latest metrics for local logging without invoking the LLM.
tracing.note: Cycle logs and MEMORY_LOG entries; no structured per-step trace reported.

replayability.evidence_quote: Auto-compacted: only the most recent 15 entries are retained, regardless of total character count.
replayability.note: History is lossily compacted; no replay facility reported.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Evaluating autonomous research agents remains an open challenge.
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark runner in the 54-path file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Mandatory Dry-Run.Before any real training launch, the Code Agent must execute a short dry-run

target_domain.evidence_quote: an open-source framework that enables large language model (LLM) agents to autonomously conduct deep learning experiments around the clock
target_domain.note: Writes/modifies training code too; primary domain is research.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Works with **both Anthropic and OpenAI** out of the box.
